:::{#exr-hessian-score}
#### Hessian from the score

Write the [Hessian](#def-hessian) $\hess$
as a derivative of the [score function](#def-score) $\score$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-hessian-score}

By @def-score, $\score = \deriv{\vth}\llik$,
so $\pt{\score} = \deriv{\vth\'}\llik$.
Then:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\vth}\pt{\score}
&= \deriv{\vth}\deriv{\vth\'}\llik
&& \text{(transpose of the score)}\\
&= \hess
&& \text{(definition of the Hessian)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
